# ztna_fqdn_application (Resource)

Application resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ztna_connector_group" "test_group" {
  name        = "terraform-test-connector-group"
  description = "Temporary group created by terraform test"
}

resource "ztna_fqdn_application" "example" {
  name        = "terraform-test-fqdn"
  group       = ztna_connector_group.test_group.oid
  description = "Made by Terraform"

  spec = [
    {
      fqdn       = "terraform-test.example.com"
      tcp_port   = "443"
      probe_type = "tcp_ping"
      probe_port = "443"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) A comma separated list of connector group IDs
- `name` (String) Name of the FQDN rule.
- `spec` (Attributes List) Spec (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `app_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the FQDN rule is enabled.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `description` (String) The description of the resource
- `icmp_allowed` (Boolean) Whether ICMP is allowed for this FQDN rule.

If omitted, defaults to true.
- `use_dc_ip` (Boolean) Whether to use datacenter IP for this FQDN rule.

If omitted, defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `anycast_ip` (String) Anycast IP address assigned to this FQDN rule.
- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `oid` (String) The UUID of the resource
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `fqdn` (String) FQDN of the rule.

Optional:

- `probe_port` (String) The probing port if the `probe_type` is `tcp_ping`.
- `probe_type` (String) The probing type.

The value can be `tcp_ping`, `icmp_ping`, or omitted.
- `tcp_port` (String) TCP port number(s).

It can be a single port number, multiple port numbers separated by comma,
or a port range like 8000-9000.

If both tcp_port and udp_port are omitted, tcp_port defaults to 443.
- `udp_port` (String) UDP port number(s).

It can be a single port number, multiple port numbers separated by comma,
or a port range like 8000-9000.

If both tcp_port and udp_port are omitted, tcp_port defaults to 443.


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_fqdn_application.example folder:::id
```

or

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_fqdn_application.example :snippet::id
```

or

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_fqdn_application.example ::device:id
```

**Note:** Please provide just one of folder, snippet, or device for the import command.
